description: Fork of exp281 (dual-stream, d_v=64, out_proj partition_sets by head, ffn+skip, soft residual_lut). Single change: embedding_dim (E) 64 -> 128. Doubles the LUT-carry width. Affects: tok_emb_E (V*E doubles), pos_emb (T*E doubles), v_lut input_dim (64->128), out_proj n_outputs (64->128), ffn_lut input_dim AND n_outputs (64->128 both), residual_lut input_dim (64->128), ln_block_end LN dim, qk_input pos_dim. Param impact: ~+60M (mainly out_proj and ffn_lut n_outputs doubling). Tests whether the E=64 LUT carry was too narrow for the dual-stream design.
